name: birch-tree
draw: Slender upright trunk marked with short horizontal dark bands and a small airy oval crown.

name: weeping-willow
draw: Rounded crown whose long thin branches hang straight down to the ground like a curtain around a short trunk.

name: cypress-tree
draw: Tall narrow flame-shaped evergreen with a pointed tip and a very short trunk.

name: lombardy-poplar
draw: Very tall thin columnar tree, crown like a narrow upright capsule on a short trunk, several times taller than wide.

name: baobab-tree
draw: Massive bottle-shaped swollen trunk topped by short stubby bare branches that look like roots.

name: acacia-tree
draw: Savanna tree with a wide flat table-top crown on a thin trunk that forks into a V below the crown.

name: joshua-tree
draw: Shaggy trunk splitting into several crooked arms, each ending in a spiky round tuft of leaves.

name: giant-sequoia
draw: Very thick straight trunk with ridged bark rising to a small conical crown high above.

name: cedar-tree
draw: Wide conifer made of three flat horizontal tiers of foliage stacked on a straight trunk.

name: monkey-puzzle-tree
draw: Tall trunk with a domed crown of upward curving rope-like branches covered in tiny scale marks.

name: dragon-blood-tree
draw: Dense umbrella-shaped crown like an upturned mushroom cap on a tight fan of branches from one trunk.

name: banyan-tree
draw: Broad spreading crown with many thin aerial roots dropping from the branches to the ground like extra trunks.

name: mangrove-tree
draw: Bushy crown on a trunk that stands above a wavy water line on arched stilt roots.

name: bonsai-tree
draw: Miniature tree with a curved twisting trunk and flat cloud-like foliage pads in a shallow rectangular tray.

name: olive-tree
draw: Short gnarled trunk twisted and split into two, supporting a loose irregular crown of small leaves.

name: elm-tree
draw: Vase-shaped tree whose branches fan upward and outward from the trunk into a wide rounded top.

name: fan-palm
draw: Straight trunk topped by several round fan-shaped leaves with pleated radiating ribs.

name: tree-fern
draw: Thin shaggy trunk crowned by long arching fern fronds with fine side leaflets.

name: travelers-palm
draw: Flat fan of long paddle leaves spread in one plane like a peacock tail on a short trunk.

name: cherry-blossom-tree
draw: Rounded tree crown made of clustered small five-petal blossoms with a few petals drifting off.

name: kapok-tree
draw: Tall trunk with a flat crown and huge flat plank-like buttress roots flaring out at its base.

name: bare-tree
draw: Leafless winter tree with a trunk dividing into symmetrical forking branches and twigs.

name: dead-tree
draw: Leaning cracked trunk with a few broken jagged branch stubs and no leaves.

name: autumn-tree
draw: Round crown tree with several loose leaves falling from it toward a small leaf pile at the base.

name: snowy-pine
draw: Conical pine tree with rounded caps of snow resting on each tier of branches.

name: tree-stump
draw: Short cut-off trunk with a flat top showing growth rings and roots spreading at the base.

name: tree-hollow
draw: Thick trunk section with a dark oval hole partway up and a branch stub above it.

name: tree-roots
draw: Tree with a small crown above a ground line and a large spreading root system drawn below it.

name: tree-of-life
draw: Circle framing a round-crowned tree whose branches above mirror its roots below and both touch the circle.

name: tree-planting
draw: Hand lowering a small sapling with a root ball into a hole in a mound of soil.

name: deforestation
draw: Row of cut tree stumps with one standing tree beside them.

name: bush
draw: Low rounded cloud-shaped shrub with no visible trunk sitting on a ground line.

name: hedge
draw: Long box-shaped clipped shrub with flat top and straight sides on a ground line.

name: topiary
draw: Shrub clipped into a perfect ball on a bare stem planted in a square pot.

name: kadomatsu
draw: Japanese New Year arrangement of three bamboo stalks cut at an angle, backed by pine sprigs and tied at the base.

name: oak-leaf
draw: Single leaf with deep rounded wavy lobes on both sides and a short stem.

name: ginkgo-leaf
draw: Fan-shaped leaf with a notch in the middle of its curved top edge and a thin stalk.

name: fern-frond
draw: Arching fern frond with a central stem and many small paired leaflets tapering to a point.

name: palm-frond
draw: Long arching palm leaf with a central rib and many narrow leaflets hanging from both sides.

name: monstera-leaf
draw: Large heart-shaped leaf with deep side splits and oval holes between the veins.

name: lily-pad
draw: Round floating leaf with a single V notch cut to the center, resting on a wavy water line.

name: bodhi-leaf
draw: Heart-shaped leaf with a long narrow drip tip and fine veins, the sacred fig leaf.

name: horse-chestnut-leaf
draw: Palmate leaf of seven long oval leaflets radiating from one point on a stalk, like a hand.

name: eucalyptus-leaf
draw: Long narrow sickle-curved leaf with a pointed tip hanging from a short stem.

name: tulip-tree-leaf
draw: Four-lobed leaf with a squared-off notched tip, shaped like a tulip outline.

name: sassafras-leaf
draw: Mitten-shaped leaf with one rounded thumb lobe on the side.

name: sweetgum-leaf
draw: Five-pointed star-shaped leaf with smooth pointed lobes on a long stalk.

name: japanese-maple-leaf
draw: Leaf with seven slender deeply cut pointed lobes spread like a delicate hand.

name: linden-leaf
draw: Lopsided heart-shaped leaf with a finely toothed edge and a short pointed tip.

name: chestnut-leaf
draw: Long narrow leaf with a strongly saw-toothed edge and straight parallel side veins.

name: ash-leaf
draw: Compound leaf made of a central stalk with pairs of oval leaflets and one leaflet at the tip.

name: pine-needles
draw: Small bundle of long straight needles joined at the base by a short sheath.

name: pine-branch
draw: Evergreen bough with a woody stem and dense short needles bristling along both sides.

name: olive-branch
draw: Curved twig with pairs of narrow pointed leaves and two small oval olives.

name: laurel-wreath
draw: Open circle of two curved branches of paired oval leaves meeting at the bottom.

name: leafy-twig
draw: Short woody twig with three alternating oval leaves and a small bud at the tip.

name: tree-branch
draw: Thick branch that splits into two smaller limbs each carrying a few leaves.

name: twig
draw: Bare forked twig with small pointed buds along its sides and at its tips.

name: leaf-skeleton
draw: Leaf outline filled only with a fine network of veins branching from the midrib.

name: leaf-pile
draw: Small heap of overlapping fallen leaves of mixed shapes on the ground.

name: falling-leaves
draw: Two leaves drifting down at angles with short curved motion lines behind them.

name: leaf-dewdrop
draw: Leaf with a single round water drop resting on its surface near the tip.

name: frosted-leaf
draw: Leaf with a jagged white frost edge and a small snowflake on its surface.

name: leaf-spot
draw: Leaf covered with several round disease spots, each with a ring around it.

name: variegated-leaf
draw: Oval leaf split along its midrib into a solid half and an outlined half with a wavy border.

name: leaf-bud
draw: Pointed closed bud with overlapping scales at the tip of a short twig.

name: lily
draw: Trumpet flower with six pointed curling petals open wide and long stamens sticking out.

name: orchid
draw: Flower with two broad round side petals, three narrow sepals and a frilled lip at the bottom, on an arching stem.

name: slipper-orchid
draw: Orchid with a rounded pouch-shaped lip at the bottom, one tall top sepal and two twisted side petals.

name: hibiscus
draw: Large five-petal flower with wide overlapping petals and a long stamen column projecting from the center.

name: cherry-blossom
draw: Five-petal blossom with a small notch at the tip of each round petal and a dotted center.

name: blossom-branch
draw: Thin crooked branch dotted with several small round blossoms and buds.

name: dandelion
draw: Round fluffy seed head on a thin stem, made of many radiating fine lines with a few seeds blowing away.

name: dandelion-seed
draw: Single seed with a thin stalk topped by a radiating umbrella of fine hairs.

name: poppy
draw: Cup of four broad crinkled petals around a dark center with a ring of stamens, on a thin hairy stem.

name: iris-flower
draw: Flower with three petals standing upright and three falling petals curving downward, on a tall stem.

name: daffodil
draw: Flower with a ring of six flat pointed petals and a long frilled trumpet in the center, seen from the side.

name: bluebell
draw: Arching stem with a row of small hanging bell flowers with curled-back tips, all along one side.

name: lily-of-the-valley
draw: Curved stem with a line of tiny round bell flowers beside one broad upright leaf.

name: snowdrop
draw: Single drooping white flower with three long outer petals hanging from a bent stem between two narrow leaves.
